description: This source file defines a NetworkStatusService class that asynchronously checks and reports the current network status using Apple's Network framework, along with utility classes and methods to handle network path monitoring and state management.

classes.name: NetworkStatusService
classes.description: A service class providing network status updates asynchronously.

classes.name: NetworkStatusState
classes.description: A utility class managing the completion state of network status checks with thread safety.

methods.name: currentStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current network status within a specified timeout.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Constructs a network status payload from a given NWPath object.

methods.name: fallbackPayload
methods.description: Provides a default network status payload used when the actual status check times out.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks the network status check as completed in a thread-safe manner, ensuring one-time completion signaling.
